top_signals.title: The Deal: Why Everyone's Watching Vanderbilt
top_signals.summary: What does it take to fit in as a coach at Vanderbilt University? On this week's episode of The Deal, Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly sit down with Candice Storey Lee, the the athletics director there, to find out what she looks for when interviewing candidates. Tune in wherever you get your podcasts (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Vylor Offers High-Grade Debt in Market’s Latest Pre-Spinoff Deal
top_signals.summary: Vylor Inc. is offering investment-grade bonds that will help finance a payout to parent Corteva Inc. as a spinoff of the seed company nears.

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis. top_signals.title: Coal India Ventures into Critical Minerals Trading
top_signals.summary: Coal India, the world’s single largest coal producer, has applied to establish a trading office in Singapore to trade critical minerals and iron ore in what would be the company’s first trading office outside India, Reuters reported on Thursday, citing anonymous sources involved in the discussions.
